verdict.rationale: llamafile documents downloading pre-built llamafiles and running them immediately, and says it supports open GGUF models such as Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Phi. Nothing in the evidence names Hugging Face or shows an integrated pull-from-Hugging-Face flow, so only the generic 'download and run open models' part is covered. Missing for 10: any documented Hugging Face integration (direct repo/model-ID pull or official Hugging Face-hosted llamafiles), a documented workflow for fetching arbitrary GGUF files from Hugging Face, and independent hands-on corroboration of such a flow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can download and run open models directly from Hugging Face

citations.quote: We provide pre-built llamafiles for a variety of models, so you can easily run them immediately without setup.
Supports GGUF models including Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Phi.
Download a model from our example llamafiles page, make it executable, and run it.
